name: Adaro Brute
body:
Adaro Brute
CR 5

This hybrid of human and shark holds its spear menacingly, thick, glistening saliva dripping from its razor-sharp teeth.

XP 1,600
NE Medium monstrous humanoid (aquatic)
Init +3; Senses Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+3 Dex, +5 natural)
hp 49 (6d10+16)
Fort +4 Ref +8 Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., swim 50 ft.
Melee spear +10/+5 (1d8+6/x3), bite +5 (1d6+4)
Ranged spear +8 (1d8+4/x3)
Special Attacks rain frenzy

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 17, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 14
Base Atk +6; CMB +10; CMD 23
Feats Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (spear)
Skills Intimidate +11, Perception +10, Stealth +12, Swim +21
Languages Aquan, Common; speak with sharks
SQ amphibious, poison use

ECOLOGY

Environment warm oceans
Organization solitary, hunting party (2-6), or tribe (7-12)
Treasure standard (3 spears, other treasure)

This hybrid of human and shark holds its spear menacingly, thick, glistening saliva dripping from its razor-sharp teeth.
